title: Learning in the classroom
scenario: You are in a teacher role. Use English naturally in this in class situation.

lines.text: Today we are going to discuss classroom communication.
I have been thinking about ways to improve my speaking.
That is great. You should also focus on listening carefully.
Could you recommend some practice activities?
Yes, I suggest you join the after-school English club.
I would if I had more free time after school.
I understand. Even ten minutes of daily practice helps.
Thank you, teacher. I will try my best.
